company_name: Suzhou Suyuan Advantec Machinery Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides essential materials like test-grade wafers and sputtering targets for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Suzhou Suyuan Advantec Machinery Co., Ltd. is a Japanese-owned enterprise specializing in manufacturing components for vacuum equipment and providing test-grade wafers for the semiconductor industry. The company also produces sputtering targets used in applications such as wave display screens, building glass, and solar cells, serving the semiconductor and related high-tech industries.
capabilities: Sputtering targets for wave display screens and solar cells
